business_problem: HappyFox needed a more accurate and reliable LLM stack because its prior external AI service struggled with factual grounding, multi-turn context retention, and response latency in customer support workflows.
solution_summary: HappyFox uses Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic's Claude 2.1, and AI Agent Copilot to support AI-powered support ticket resolution and agent copilots.
